scenes.title: Hybrid RAG for Encompass
scenes.body: Two knowledge stores ground the assistants: ICE artifacts plus Developer Connect docs. Keyword JSON always works; pgvector adds semantic recall when Postgres and OpenAI are available.

scenes.title: ICE · Dev Connect docs
scenes.body: ice-knowledge.service reads data/knowledge/ice-sources.json and ice_knowledge_chunks. encompass-docs.service reads data/encompass-docs.json and encompass_docs_chunks. Same hybrid pattern, separate tables.

scenes.title: Repos · Postman · docs
scenes.body: Drop ICE sample repos, Postman collections, and Dev Connect snapshots under knowledge-sources/ice/. Scrape merges Developer Connect pages by title/category — partial scrapes do not wipe the seed.

scenes.title: Normalize · hash · embed
scenes.body: npm run build:ice-knowledge normalizes records into ice-sources.json. npm run scrape:encompass-docs refreshes docs JSON. Both backfills upsert pgvector rows by content_hash — unchanged chunks skip re-embed.

scenes.title: 1536-d · HNSW cosine
scenes.body: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small via embedding-utils. ensureKnowledgeVectorTable creates embedding vector(1536) plus an HNSW cosine index. Search uses embedding <=> query; score is 1 minus distance.

scenes.title: Promise.all · merge · boost
scenes.body: search() runs searchVector and searchKeyword in parallel. Vector hits get +5 score boost, then dedupe by repo|url|title. No DATABASE_URL, pgvector, or API key — vector lane returns []; keyword lane still answers.

scenes.title: Assistant · Unit Tests AI
scenes.body: encompass-assistant.controller and unit-tests-ai search both stores, assemble context, then call the LLM. executionAllowed stays false — retrieval only, never live ICE API execution from RAG hits.

scenes.title: refresh:encompass-knowledge
scenes.body: Combined refresh scrapes docs then rebuilds ICE. Toggle ENCOMPASS_DOCS_SKIP_EMBED or ICE_SKIP_EMBED for JSON-only. GraphRAG on graph_nodes.embedding is a sibling path for disaster pipeline AI — not live /near proximity.
